bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating baseline stances of LLMs on 107 contentious societal and political issues using neutrally-framed prompts, and systematically measuring how these output stances shift when models are presented with varying configurations of human-written arguments (one-sided, balanced, or clear and convincing).

Calculating the baseline percentage of 'pro' versus 'con' responses to neutrally-framed issue questions (in the absence of arguments) to identify an inherent leaning of the model towards affirmative positions.
